title: Transforming Bad Habits Into Good Ones

scenes.text: 50% of adults struggle with procrastination daily.
Incorporating just 2 minutes of task initiation can reduce delays by 70%.
Adopting a '2-minute rule' transformed countless lives, making tasks manageable.
Follow for your daily dose of discipline.
